name: Run trace drawer: project context docs with status, and the untrusted block
description: Deterministic (no model call) walk through the seeded Security Reviewer run on PR #482. Opens the Agent runs tab and the run's trace drawer; the Configuration section's 'Specs read' lists the three docs seed.ts stores in the trace with their status words as plain text ('included', 'skipped_budget', 'missing'); expanding Prompt assembly and the 'Project context — attached specs (untrusted)' entry shows the stored <untrusted source="specs/security-baseline.md"> block. The three seeded runs share one 'Open run trace & logs' button label, so the flow takes the last one in the timeline: runs are listed newest first and seed.ts inserts the Security Reviewer run first (oldest); the drawer title is asserted so a different order fails loudly instead of checking the wrong run. Read-only. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (hermetic runner / e2e-web.yml).
